quotes.text: Small steps every day add up to big change.
Discipline is choosing what you want most over what you want now.
You don't have to be extreme, just consistent.
The body achieves what the mind believes.
Motivation gets you started. Habit keeps you going.
One workout at a time. One meal at a time. One day at a time.
Rest if you must, but don't quit.
Strength grows in the moments you think you can't go on.
Your only competition is who you were yesterday.
Sweat today, smile tomorrow.
Progress, not perfection.
Every rep is a vote for the person you're becoming.
Good habits are worth being a little stubborn about.
It never gets easier. You get stronger.
The best time to start was yesterday. The next best time is now.
Take care of your body. It's the only place you have to live.
A year from now you'll wish you had started today.
What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
Slow progress is still progress.
Drink the water. Walk the walk. Sleep the sleep.
Consistency beats intensity.
You are one decision away from a better day.
Don't count the days. Make the days count.
Health is a relationship between you and your body.
Fitness is earned, one choice at a time.
Energy comes from movement, not from waiting for it.
Eat for the body you want, not the body you have.
Habits are the compound interest of self-improvement.
You will never regret a workout you finished.
Showing up is half the battle. You're here.
